premium-codex-claude.use_when: High-risk, ambiguous, architecture-heavy, customer-facing runtime AI, or sensitive production work.
premium-codex-claude.forbidden_when: Never use as an excuse to skip human review.

low-cost-routine.model_target: Candidate low-cost coding worker after eval, for example Kimi Code or another routed agent.
low-cost-routine.use_when: Low-risk scoped implementation, parser cleanup, small refactors, or boilerplate.
low-cost-routine.forbidden_when: Task touches auth, billing, Stripe, RLS, migrations, secrets, production deploy logic, or runtime AI policy.

low-cost-docs.model_target: Candidate low-cost docs worker after eval.
low-cost-docs.use_when: README, docs, playbooks, demo scripts, and skill wording.
low-cost-docs.forbidden_when: Docs change carries legal, pricing, customer promise, or security implications.

low-cost-tests.model_target: Candidate low-cost test worker after eval.
low-cost-tests.use_when: Focused tests around stable behavior and test-only cleanup.
low-cost-tests.forbidden_when: Test requires product-code changes outside the explicit acceptance criteria.

batch-candidate.model_target: Candidate batch processor after eval, with generated output reviewed before application.
batch-candidate.use_when: Many similar docs, client starter variants, issue triage drafts, or content transformations.
batch-candidate.forbidden_when: Any sensitive surface or unreviewed write path is involved.

tasks.title: Improve local release docs
tasks.prompt: Update the local release checklist with one troubleshooting note for a missing Python dependency. Do not change product code.
success_criteria: The added note is actionable from Windows PowerShell.

tasks.title: Add parser regression tests
tasks.prompt: Add one focused regression test for local SEO JSON fence parsing. Match the existing pytest style.
success_criteria: The test documents a stable parser behavior.

tasks.title: Polish non-sensitive widget copy
tasks.prompt: Make a small non-sensitive copy improvement in the widget preview text and keep mirrored widget assets synchronized.

tasks.title: Generate client starter variants
tasks.prompt: Draft five client starter kit variants for common website builders as generated output for human review.
success_criteria: Output is generated for review before application.

tasks.title: Change Stripe webhook behavior
tasks.prompt: Modify billing webhook behavior for subscription upgrades and update pricing copy.
success_criteria: Human plan is reviewed before implementation.

tasks.title: Add Supabase RLS migration
tasks.prompt: Add a migration changing tenant isolation policy for leads.
success_criteria: Migration plan is reviewed before implementation.
RLS and tenant isolation are explicitly checked.
